title: KS 27 | U.S. Marines and HIMARS land in Ishigaki
description: U.S. Marines with 12th Marine Littoral Regiment, 3rd Marine Division, along with a M142 High Mobility Artillery Rocket System attached to the 1-17 Field Artillery Regiment, 3rd Multi-Domain Task Force, disembark a U.S. Marine Corps KC-130J Super Hercules assigned to Marine Aerial Refueler Transport Squadron (VMGR) 152, 1st Marine Aircraft Wing, during exercise Keen Sword 27 at Ishigaki, Japan, Oct. 15, 2026. Keen Sword is a routine, biennial bilateral field training exercise with multinational participation, designed to increase readiness and interoperability between the U.S. military and Japan Self-Defense Forces while strengthening the ironclad U.S.-Japan Alliance. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Justin Cledera)
